The connection between the fine silver chain and the outermost beads is ambiguous. The chain appears to merge into the bead cap without a clear jump ring or secure mechanical attachment point, suggesting a minor fusion artifact common in AI generation.
The grain and layers of the background prop seem slightly warped and inconsistent with a rigid physical object, though it is out of focus.
